stemMd: A tank initially holds 80 litres. Water enters at 7 litres per minute and leaves at 3 litres per minute. When will it hold 140 litres?
explanationMd: Net inflow is 4 litres per minute. The required increase is 60 litres, so time=60/4=15 minutes.

distractorRationale.a: Adds inflow and outflow instead of subtracting.
